primary: Region-conditioned bank of standardized multinomial logistic regressions; region selects a model and is never a signal feature
comparison: Pooled signal-only logistic regression without region input
selection: Fit scaler and model on train only; choose C using validation balanced accuracy; ties prefer first C; freeze before test signals are generated
grouping: All three conditions of a seed and nuisance configuration remain in one partition; seeds and groups are unique across regions

bootstrap.unit: whole test configuration with all three labels

scope: Synthetic model stimulus conditions, not subjective pain, clinical outcomes or biological validation
test_access: Test signals are generated only after candidate.json is frozen; no retuning after viewing held-out results
